Boat information

Cruise speed changes open-water timing. Recorded slow sections stay slow; a lower cruise speed also limits those sections.

Low-water alerts

An adjustable tide-height alert, not a depth or draft clearance. The two new checkpoints use nearby NOAA station estimates. See sources and how alerts work.

Bridge delays · live what-if

Albany Avenue and Dorset Avenue default to expected waits from your arrival date and Eastern time. Choose Manual slider at either bridge to use a 0–30 minute assumption instead. Other movable bridges retain their sliders. Boat height determines whether an opening is needed; estimated closed passes add no wait.

On-signal service adds no timetable wait. Advance-notice periods wait until regular service unless you confirm that the required four-hour notice is already arranged. Special-event exceptions are flagged for review. Schedules, dates & examples

Predictions & assumptions

Timing follows the recorded route and its slower sections, reused in reverse for southbound trips. Albany and Dorset can use published opening schedules evaluated at each arrival or manual slider waits. Other movable bridges use manual waits. Waits apply only for indicated openings or unchecked crossings when height is entered; without height all movable crossings are assumed to need openings. On-signal service adds zero timetable wait; opening and maneuvering time are not included. Stops are passage positions on the recorded route, not marina detours; Barnegat Inlet means the nearby ICW junction.

NOAA high/low tide times and heights are saved with this page. Heights between those events use a smooth cosine estimate and are marked estimated. Rising/falling refers to water level, not current direction.

Station ETAs refer to the closest passage position on your track. Stations in adjacent creeks or branches are shown with their offset; their tide may differ from the ICW. The route coloring interpolates nearby station heights and is a broader spatial estimate.

Best/lowest departures maximize/minimize the lowest tide height at Main Marsh Thorofare (8534393), Ludlam Bay, west side (8535221), Nummy Island, Grassy Sound Channel (8535661), Wildwood Crest, Sunset Lake (8535838), Ocean City, Beesleys Point near red 280 (proxy: NOAA 8534975), and Great Thoroughfare, Atlantic City near G207 at the Bader Field runway end (proxy: NOAA 8534638), evaluated at their individual pass-by ETAs. Only priority stations within the selected passage affect rankings; other stations remain informational. Short passages containing none of these six locations have no departure recommendation. This is not a least-depth or clearance calculation; local charted depths are not supplied, and draft is not used for depth calculations. Boat height and margin are used for estimated bridge clearance checks; fixed-bridge conflicts exclude departure candidates. Passage duration does not change with tidal current.

The low-water alert checks the estimated tide at arrival against your chosen level (default 1.0 ft MLLW). It is an on-page alert, not a text, email or live monitoring service. The Great Thoroughfare, Atlantic City priority tide is evaluated near G207, separately from the rail bridge crossing and its wait. The two added checkpoint markers show your requested locations; their heights are explicitly nearby-station proxy estimates with no local time or height correction. Source details.

Predictions are feet above mean lower low water (MLLW), the usual tidal chart datum. Weather and wind-driven water-level departures are not modeled. A 2022 recorded route does not verify present channel depths or safe navigation.
